reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching this dataset's recorded Total Assets against the labelled Balance Sheet columns in the bank's own annual reports, independently in FIVE separate years: (1) FY2013 report: Solo 'Balance Sheet' Total Property and Assets = 121,963,432,985 (line ~7238) vs Consolidated Balance Sheet Total Property and Assets = 124,333,581,699 (line ~6952) -- this dataset's stored value (121,963mn) matches Solo exactly. (2) FY2014 report: Solo Total Property and Assets = 126,758,380,230 (line ~7219) vs Consolidated = 129,532,464,451 (line ~6930) -- stored value (126,758mn) matches Solo. (3) FY2020 report: Solo Total Property and Assets = 293,517,852,175 (line ~18016) vs Consolidated = 295,967,778,349 (line ~17668) -- stored value (293,518mn) matches Solo. (4) FY2022 report: Solo Total Property and Assets = 339,818,866,156 (line ~23729) vs Consolidated = 342,727,632,326 (line ~23376) -- stored value (339,819mn) matches Solo. (5) FY2025 report: Solo Total Property and Assets = 427,425,708,361 (Annexure-F 'Highlights of Performance of the Bank', ~line 17690-17742, and independently in the 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' interim table, ~line 5554-5570) vs an explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' Total Property and Assets = 429,466,291,292 (line ~17481-17519) and an explicitly-labelled 'D) Consolidated Position' block within the FY2025 Five-Years Financial Summary itself (Total Assets 429,466mn, line ~5590) -- stored value (427,426mn) matches Solo. The Consolidated figure is consistently ~0.7-2.3% higher than Solo throughout, reflecting consolidation of an Offshore Banking Unit (OBU) and a brokerage subsidiary (SJIBL Securities Limited, whose margin-investment/client-negative-equity notes appear throughout the FY2018-2024 reports). Every year's 'Five Years Financial Summary' table in every annual report 2011-2025 is unambiguously the SOLO series (self-consistent across all 15 reports as republished), so all 15 years in this dataset are Solo. EXTENDED 2026-08-26 to the Q1/Q2/Q3 interim series: the 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and Board' table (present in every own annual report FY2015-2025) is ALSO Solo throughout -- confirmed in every one of those 11 years by matching the table's own 31-Dec column against the already-verified Solo quarterly/<YEAR>_Q4.json figures (exact match every year, e.g. FY2025 427,425.71mn to the cent). No Consolidated-basis contamination found in this table in any year. See sources array entry '2014-2025 Q1/Q2/Q3 (interim, embedded annual-report table)' for full detail.
notes: annual_reports/SHAHJABANK archive covers 2011-2025 (15 years, the full requested span) -- all 15 text files sanity-checked (wc -l 11,022 to 36,053 lines; spot-read headers) and confirmed to be genuine, non-scanned pdftotext extractions, not stubs. Shariah-based Islamic bank; reports 'Investment' rather than conventional 'Loans and Advances', and 'Classified Investment'/'Non-Performing Investment' rather than 'NPL', consistent with the convention already used for EXIMBANK and FIRSTSBANK in this dataset. Every one of the 15 annual reports was parsed (both with a generic multi-year-summary-table extractor and by direct reading), and each year's own contemporaneous 'Five Years Financial Summary' (or 'Financial Summary'/'Performance of the bank at a glance' in 2011-2014) table was cross-checked against how the SAME figures are republished as comparative columns in every subsequent report that carries them (i.e. each of the ~50-90 rows in each table was checked against up to 4 other reports' comparative columns for that same year) -- this is a materially more internally-consistent bank than IFIC (85 restatements found in a prior session) or ISLAMIBANK (83): only 5 genuine restatements and 1 corrected arithmetic error were found across the full 15-year, ~15-table cross-check (see 'discrepancies_found' below), plus a routine, expected, non-flagged pattern of EPS retrospective restatement for bonus/stock dividends (BAS-33) that recurs almost every year and is not individually itemised. Every quarterly/<YEAR>_Q4.json line item is sourced from that year's OWN annual report (the contemporaneous figure), per project rule, except FY2013's car_pct which is corrected per the 'arithmetically impossible contemporaneous figure' exception (see that year's entry below).

BASIS CONFIRMED SOLO in every one of the 11 own-report years, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series: each year's own 31-Dec column in this same table reproduces the already-validated quarterly/<YEAR>_Q4.json Solo figures exactly (e.g. FY2018 Total Assets 243,659.89 vs 243660mn; FY2022 339,818.87 vs 339819mn; FY2025 427,425.71 vs 427425.71mn to the cent) in every single year checked (2015-2025) -- no Consolidated-basis contamination found anywhere in this table. FY2016, FY2019, FY2021 stable on all absolute BDT-value figures; per-share figures (EPS/NAV per share/NOCFPS) retrospectively restated in the following year's comparative column due to intervening bonus-share issuances (same BAS-33 pattern already documented for the annual series' EPS, now confirmed to extend to Q1/Q2/Q3 granularity and to NAV/share and NOCFPS as well) -- largest swing FY2018's comparative-in-FY2019 (~9-10% reduction, tracking FY2019's ~10% bonus issue); absolute totals (assets, equity, deposits, investment, income, expenses, PAT) are NEVER affected by these per-share restatements. FY2019's Dec-only column reproduces the already-documented ~111mn Deposits/Assets divergence exactly. FY2021: trivial 0.01 rounding in Mar-21 Operating Expenses (988.84 vs 988.83), immaterial. FY2023: a small, isolated restatement of ONLY the Mar-23 column's per-share figures in FY2024's comparative (EPS 0.99->0.97, NAV 21.14->20.52, NOCFPS 12.83->12.45; Jun/Sep/Dec-23 unaffected) -- immaterial, likely a technical weighted-average-share correction. All contemporaneous (own-report) figures were kept in quarterly/<YEAR>_Q1-Q3.json per project convention; every restatement above is recorded here rather than silently reconciled. INTRA-YEAR FINDING (see insights.json for full detail): decomposing each year's cumulative PAT into standalone quarters reveals SHAHJABANK's FY2024 full-year PAT of 1,688mn conceals a strong first three quarters (cumulative PAT reached an interim high of 4,048.19mn by 30-Sep-2024) followed by a single-quarter Q4 net swing of -2,360.19mn -- entirely a below-operating-profit-line event (Operating Profit itself grew every single quarter of 2024, Q4 included) consistent with a concentrated year-end provisioning catch-up. A milder version of the same Q4-compression pattern recurs in FY2022 (+74.62mn, smallest quarter of the year but still positive), FY2023 (-51.26mn, first negative Q4) and FY2025 (-234.26mn) -- a 4-year escalating trend not visible from the Q4-only annual series alone. A similar (but not identical -- Q1/Q2 rather than Q4) below-the-line swing produced a cumulative NET LOSS position through 30-Jun-2014 (-598.70mn) before a large Q3 reversal (+814.60mn) brought the year back to its already-known 747mn full-year profit.

sources.note: ACCESS: sjiblbd.com's primary domain is behind a BotGuard JS captcha wall (action="https://sg-sgp-xe1.botguard.net/captcha") that blocks plain curl/wget for both the listing page and every file under it -- confirmed not a filename issue, the landing page itself returns a 'Security check required' challenge to curl. WORKAROUND: the Q1 file was retrieved successfully via the bank's own unwalled mirror domain, sjibplc.com (identical file/directory layout, no captcha observed); the H1 file was not yet present on that mirror as of retrieval, so it was instead retrieved via the WebFetch tool directly against the primary sjiblbd.com URL, which succeeded where curl did not (WebFetch appears to use a different fetch path that the BotGuard challenge does not block) -- both files verified as genuine PDFs via `file` before use. BASIS: SOLO/SEPARATE, taken from the pages explicitly headed 'Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC.' (distinct from the earlier 'Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC. and its Subsidiary' Consolidated pages in the same PDF) -- verified per project standing instruction rather than assumed, matching this bank's established all-Solo convention (see reporting_basis field and the FY2015-2025 interim entry above). PROOF: each Solo Balance Sheet's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Property and Assets 427,425,708,361) reproduces the dataset's already-validated quarterly/2025_Q4.json Solo figure (427,425.71m) to the taka. EXTRACTION: both PDFs are scanner output (pdftotext extracted 0 lines on every page of both documents, confirmed via pdfinfo/pdftotext -layout); rather than OCR (tesseract), figures were read directly and visually from clean 300dpi page renders of the Solo statements -- the scanned typeset tables are cleanly legible at this resolution, and this is more reliable than OCR for a document this size (24 pages). No classified-investment/NPL breakdown or Capital Adequacy (CRAR) disclosure exists anywhere in either 24-page filing (confirmed by reading through to the final numbered note in each) -- a genuine feature of the filing, not a research gap. VALIDATED: balance-sheet identity and full P&L waterfall (Total Operating Income - Expenses = Profit before Provision - Total Provision = PBT - Tax = PAT) reconcile exactly to the taka in both quarters. The H1 filing's P&L additionally discloses a bonus discrete Apr-Jun 2026 column (Q2-alone): PAT 1,843,525,776, EPS 1.66 -- cross-validated against Q1's cumulative PAT (1,262,274,184): sum = 3,105,799,960, matching the H1 filing's own cumulative PAT (3,105,799,959) to within BDT 1 rounding. Full detail in bank_financials/SHAHJABANK/quarterly/2026_Q1.json, 2026_Q2.json.
